title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 010
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute battery variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Battery outline with an empty body and a terminal nub on the right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a battery shape without any visible charge bars.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the filled levels when the body should remain empty inside.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the same battery shell used by the family but with no interior bars.

items.depicts_observation: Battery outline with one vertical charge bar near the left side
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a low battery symbol with one visible charge segment.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for higher charge levels when only one vertical bar should be shown.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds exactly one interior bar inside the standard battery shell.

items.depicts_observation: Battery outline with two vertical charge bars inside the body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a battery level between low and high with two bars.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for one three or four bar levels when the count must stay at two.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot clearly shows two evenly spaced charge bars inside the battery shell.

items.depicts_observation: Battery outline with three vertical charge bars inside the body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a battery symbol that looks mostly charged but not full.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the two or four bar levels when the count of interior bars matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot increases the charge bars to three while keeping the same outer battery shell.

items.depicts_observation: Battery outline with four vertical charge bars filling most of the body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the fullest battery state in this five icon battery group.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for lower battery levels when all four charge bars should stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the densest battery level with four interior bars spanning the shell.
